notes.title: Demo Patch v1.2 Now Live
notes.content:
Hi there!

The demo build of PILLORY has been updated.

This update includes a bunch of new flavour text for environments (meaning more stuff has text when interacted with), some bugfixes for the combat system, and fixes for grammar issues in certain text boxes.

Please let me know right away if there are any issues!

Thank you,
IODINE
